panels.title: 1. Rides - from request to payment (exact counts from the database)

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS inserted FROM bookings
SELECT count(*) AS rejected FROM rejected_records
SELECT count(*) FROM bookings WHERE driver_id IS NOT NULL
SELECT count(*) FROM bookings WHERE booking_status='COMPLETED'
SELECT count(*) FROM payments WHERE payment_status='COMPLETED'
SELECT booking_status AS status, count(*) AS rides FROM bookings GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Ride events per second (ride.events topic)
panels.description: Every state change of every ride is also an event in Kafka

panels.title: 2. Drivers - offers, accepts, rejects (stored in driver_responses AND ride.events)

targets.rawSql: SELECT response, count(*) AS answers FROM driver_responses GROUP BY 1

panels.title: Outcome of answers
panels.description: ASSIGNED = won the ride, LOST = another driver was faster, DECLINED = rejected, EXPIRED = timeout

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(outcome,'WAITING') AS outcome, count(*) AS answers FROM driver_responses GROUP BY 1

panels.title: Race losers (LOST)
panels.description: Drivers who pressed ACCEPT after someone else won - proof that only one driver gets a ride

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM driver_responses WHERE outcome='LOST'

SELECT r.responded_at AS time, r.booking_id, r.driver_id, d.driver_name, r.dispatch_round AS round, r.response, r.outcome FROM driver_responses r JOIN drivers d USING (driver_id) WHERE r.responded_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY r.responded_at DESC LIMIT 25

panels.title: 3. Traffic and high availability - load balancer, API copies, Kafka
API requests / s per copy (load balancing)
Consumer lag per group (Kafka is the shock absorber)
4. Surge pricing - demand vs available drivers per area
6. Data quality and resilience - rejections, retries, DLQ, consistency

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM rejected_records WHERE error_code='DUPLICATE_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY'

panels.title: Replays skipped
panels.description: Re-delivered Kafka messages recognised by processed_events and skipped

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT booking_id FROM driver_responses WHERE outcome='ASSIGNED' GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*) > 1) x
SELECT error_code AS reason, count(*) AS rows FROM rejected_records GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC
SELECT rejected_at AS time, booking_id, idempotency_key, stage, error_code, error_message FROM rejected_records ORDER BY rejected_at DESC LIMIT 25
